lemma pow_two_mod_seven_period (n k : ℕ) :
    (2 ^ (3 * k + n)) % 7 = (2 ^ n) % 7 := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    calc
      (2 ^ (3 * (k + 1) + n)) % 7
      _ = (2 ^ (3 * k + 3 + n)) % 7 := by ring_nf
      _ = (2 ^ (3 * k + n) * 2 ^ 3) % 7 := by rw [← Nat.pow_add]; ring_nf
      _ = ((2 ^ (3 * k + n) % 7) * (2 ^ 3 % 7)) % 7 := by rw [Nat.mul_mod]
      _ = ((2 ^ n % 7) * 1) % 7 := by rw [ih]; norm_num
      _ = (2 ^ n) % 7 := by simp

lemma pow_two_mod_seven_zero_case (k : ℕ) : (2 ^ (3 * k)) % 7 = 1 := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [show 3 * (k + 1) = 3 * k + 3 by ring]
    rw [Nat.pow_add, Nat.mul_mod]
    simp [ih]
    <;> norm_num

lemma pow_two_mod_seven_one_case (k : ℕ) : (2 ^ (3 * k + 1)) % 7 = 2 := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [show 3 * (k + 1) + 1 = 3 * k + 4 by ring]
    rw [show 3 * k + 4 = 3 * k + 1 + 3 by ring]
    rw [Nat.pow_add, Nat.mul_mod]
    simp [ih]
    <;> norm_num

lemma pow_two_mod_seven_two_case (k : ℕ) : (2 ^ (3 * k + 2)) % 7 = 4 := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [show 3 * (k + 1) + 2 = 3 * k + 5 by ring]
    rw [show 3 * k + 5 = 3 * k + 2 + 3 by ring]
    rw [Nat.pow_add, Nat.mul_mod]
    simp [ih]
    <;> norm_num

lemma dvd_of_pow_mod_eq_one (n : ℕ) (h : 2 ^ n % 7 = 1) : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 := by omega

lemma div_by_three_iff_rem_zero (n : ℕ) : 3 ∣ n ↔ n % 3 = 0 := by omega

lemma mod_three_cases (n : ℕ) : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by omega

lemma n_eq_when_rem_zero (n : ℕ) (h : n % 3 = 0) : n = 3 * (n / 3) := by
  have h₁ : n = n % 3 + 3 * (n / 3) := by omega
  rw [h] at h₁

  omega

lemma n_eq_when_rem_two (n : ℕ) (h : n % 3 = 2) : n = 3 * (n / 3) + 2 := by

  omega

lemma pow_two_mod_seven_cases (n : ℕ) : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 ∨ (2 ^ n) % 7 = 2 ∨ (2 ^ n) % 7 = 4 := by
  have h : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := mod_three_cases n
  rcases h with (h | h | h)
  · -- Case: n % 3 = 0
    have h₁ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 1 := by
      have h₂ : n = 3 * (n / 3) := n_eq_when_rem_zero n h
      rw [h₂]
      exact pow_two_mod_seven_zero_case (n / 3)
    exact Or.inl h₁
  · -- Case: n % 3 = 1
    have h₁ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 := by
      have h₂ : n = 3 * (n / 3) + 1 := n_eq_when_rem_one n h
      rw [h₂]
      exact pow_two_mod_seven_one_case (n / 3)
    exact Or.inr (Or.inl h₁)
  · -- Case: n % 3 = 2
    have h₁ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 4 := by
      have h₂ : n = 3 * (n / 3) + 2 := n_eq_when_rem_two n h
      rw [h₂]
      exact pow_two_mod_seven_two_case (n / 3)
    exact Or.inr (Or.inr h₁)
